# DirectX Shader Compiler

`tools/fxconv.py` runs `dxc.exe` from here. `python install_deps.py` (in `rebuild/`) downloads it; or put `dxc.exe` and
`dxcompiler.dll` from a release of https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/releases (bin/x64) in this
folder. They are not in the repository.
